decision.rationale: The single-case transport completed the canaries and all 120 planner attempts, but actual-graph materialization raised a Pydantic validation error when an otherwise valid 128-character provider reason was prefixed into a 128-character runtime field. This is a demonstrated runtime/harness boundary defect, not architecture quality. One harness-only corrective attempt is permitted without changing cases, prompts, models, gold, gates, or scientific method.

failure.cause: The runtime added an architecture-selected prefix after validating the provider reason at the same 128-character ceiling.

limitations: No hidden gold was opened and no architecture cell was scored.
The two transport failures were already designed to become safe no-action quality evidence and did not invalidate the run.
The result says nothing about the relative quality of A, B, C, or C+V.
